      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "user request",
      "rationale": "Adds the requested testsubmitpackage RPC method to address an established gap where wallets could not pre-flight test CPFP packages or package RBF without mutating the mempool. The PR directly addresses user demand tracked in #32160, providing a significant missing capability for wallet developers."
